title: Mindbroken (Condition)
html:
Mindbroken

  • Affected entity is  Slowed by the Netherbrain's psyche-shattering might.

Properties

UID: END_NETHERBRAIN_SLOW

 Stack ID: SLOW

 Loses duration: end of turn

Honour mode

  • Mindbroken creatures cannot be  Hastened, and Mindbreaking a creature will end Haste.

 Stack ID: HASTE

 Stack priority: 12

Grants:

Slow: Actions
You can't take both an action and a bonus action. If you take an action, you lose a bonus action, and vice versa. You also can't make more than 1 attack per turn.
Slow: Casting
If you cast a spell that costs 1  Action, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you hang in prepare phase and skip turn. On your next turn you must spend an action point and finish casting. If you don't have an action point, the spell is cancelled.

Bugs

  •  Slow: Casting is non-functional and spells cast by slowed creatures will never be delayed.
  •  Slow: Actions does not prevent a creature from making multiple attacks unless they somehow become Slowed between attacks on their own turn.

Sources of Mindbroken

  • Retributive Brainquake
